items.title: 33.1 Properties and Quality of Water (pani ki properties aur quality) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.1 (PDF 247-249); the water-molecule drawing is our own.

blocks.text: Pani ki chemical aur physical properties (khasiyatein) samajhna zaroori hai, kyun ke inhi se pata chalta hai ke darya, jheel waghera (water bodies) mein pollution (aaloodgi) kis qism ki aur kitni hai. Pani ka molecule (H₂O) permanent dipole hai: is ke O wale sire par thora negative (δ⁻) aur H wale siron par thora positive (δ⁺) charge hota hai. Yehi polarity pani ko aisi khaas properties deti hai jo zindagi aur mahol ke liye zaroori hain. Pani ke structure (banawat) se nikalne wali kuch khaas (peculiar) properties neeche hain.

blocks.alt: Darmiyan mein pani ka aik molecule: surkh O par delta-minus aur dono neele H par delta-plus. Oopar wale molecule ka H darmiyani O se, aur darmiyani molecule ke dono H neeche wale do molecules ke O se purple dashed lakeeron (hydrogen bonds) se jure hain.
blocks.caption: Pani ka polar molecule aur hydrogen bonds (hamari drawing; kitab is hisse mein koi figure nahi chhapti).
blocks.long_description: Oxygen electrons ko zyada khenchta hai, is liye O sira thora manfi (delta-minus) aur H sire thore musbat (delta-plus) hote hain. Aik molecule ka H doosre molecule ke O ki taraf kashish (attraction) mehsoos karta hai: yehi hydrogen bond hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Darmiyan wale molecule ko dekhein: O par δ⁻ aur dono H par δ⁺ hai. Aik molecule ka δ⁺ H doosre molecule ke δ⁻ O ki taraf khinchta hai; purple dashed lakeerein yahi hydrogen bonds hain. Inhi bonds ki wajah se pani ki specific heat aur heat of vaporisation zyada hai, aur pani ions ko gher kar ghol leta hai.
